label: Design system logo
help: Use a logo from the active design system. Turn off to leave the logo out.

label: Link
help: The page this card points at. Only the site is printed, without the protocol, so a long address stays out of the artwork.

label: Title
default: Quiet interfaces do more with less
help: The page title. Nothing here fetches the page, so type it in.

label: Description
default: A field note on restraint - fewer controls, clearer defaults, and what happens when a product stops shouting.
help: The line under the title. Two lines is the most that reads well at thumbnail size.

label: Site name
help: Printed in the chip beside the address. Its first letter is the monogram on the chip.

label: Thumbnail
help: Drop in a picture, or paste a Lolly URL Screenshot link to grab the page itself. Leave it empty and the card prints a monogram panel.

label: Zoom & position
help: Zoom scales the thumbnail up. X and Y pan it inside its panel. Drag a label or type a value.

label: Size
help: Where the card is going. Picking one sets the export size, so the file comes out at the size the platform wants.

label: Accent
help: The chip, the rule under the title, and the monogram panel that stands in for a missing thumbnail.
